name: Glidy Addons for Elementor
author: Glidy Addons

sections.description:
Glidy Addons for Elementor brings smooth animations and creative widgets to build stunning, interactive websites with ease using Elementor.

The Features

  • 23+ creative widgets
  • Theme Builder like header, footer, archives, single pages builder
  • Custom CSS feature
  • Responsive Controls
  • Lightweight & Fast
  • Elementor Compatibility
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility
  • Regular Updates
  • No Coding Required
  • Easy to use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/glidy-addons-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Elementor editor to access and use the widgets.
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Page Builder?

No, this plugin is an addon specifically for Elementor, so it requires Elementor Page Builder to function.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes! The plugin will work with any theme that is compatible with Elementor.
